selected_source_sha256: Must equal the selected source binding.

row_fields.path: relative saved source path under evidence
row_fields.lines: positive actual line count at most 350

patches.type: list; empty when no source delta exists

artifacts.type: list; unique relative paths disjoint from variants

row_fields.bytes: actual byte count, including zero for retained empty outputs

rejected_public_types.type: list; stems must equal rejected PUBLIC binding exactly

row_fields.stem: actual successful Lean public job rejected at TYPE review
row_fields.artifacts: nonempty list of pinned artifact paths

coverage: Every actual non-public source input must byte-match a variant. Every repair patch must reconstruct its two variants by its exact recorded labels. Every failed or warned command remains in JOBS_JSON. Every rejected PUBLIC job remains in both its binding and history list. Unsubmitted drafts and metadata diagnostics remain pinned variants or artifacts without adding jobs.
immutability: The entire actual gate must equal __H17_SOURCE_HISTORY_JSON__. No history event is invented by this template.
